focus.name: scene-resource-queued-actor
focus.purpose: Bound the compact scene-resource actor-instantiation helper and identify its gate, coordinate cursor, allocator, and fixed template inputs.

limitations: No direct static caller is present in the current whole-ROM reference export; the helper may be reached through an indirect or externally selected scene-resource path.
The coordinate-record stream extent and the independent runtime producer for the spawn gate remain unresolved.
